description: Ask verify402 whether a cross-venue arbitrage opportunity is REAL, right now. Quotes come from Uniswap's canonical QuoterV2 and each DEX router at one pinned block. The honest answer is usually 'no_edge' - that IS the product. Costs $0.05 per call.

base.description: Token to trade from, e.g. "USDC" (default USDC)

chainId.description: REQUIRED. 1 Ethereum, 42161 Arbitrum, 8453 Base. There is no default; omitting it returns 400 missing_chain.

size.description: Trade size in whole base units, e.g. 100000 (default 100000)

target.description: Token to buy and sell back, e.g. "WETH"

name: verify_arbitrage
